mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
